title: PDFWordConfidenceExtractionOutput
description: Schema for PDF text extraction with normalized word-level confidence scores and agentic LLM correction metadata.

filename.description: Name or relative path of the processed PDF file.

extraction_engine.description: Identification of the extraction engine or hybrid pipeline used.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the extraction.

total_words.description: Total number of extracted words across all pages.

mean_confidence.description: Arithmetic mean of confidence scores across all extracted words.

min_confidence.description: Lowest confidence score encountered across all words.

low_confidence_count.description: Count of words scoring below the specified low_confidence_threshold.

low_confidence_threshold.description: The confidence score cutoff below which words are flagged.

human_corrections_count.description: Count of words manually verified or corrected by human reviewer.

llm_corrections_count.description: Count of words corrected by the agentic LLM model.

llm_approved_count.description: Count of low-confidence words confirmed and approved as-is by the LLM model.

llm_model.description: Identifier of the LLM model used for agentic word correction (e.g. gemini-3.7-flash).

last_modified_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the latest review or correction.

full_text.description: Consolidated plain text from the entire document, formatted for immediate NLP/LLM consumption.

page_type.description: The extraction source modality for this specific page.

width.description: Page width in points (72 points = 1 inch).

height.description: Page height in points (72 points = 1 inch).

word_count.description: Number of words extracted from this page.

mean_confidence.description: Average word confidence score for this page.

text.description: Full extracted plain text for this specific page.

words.description: Ordered list of individual words with coordinates and confidence scores.

source.description: Origin of the word token recognition.

line_number.description: Optional 1-based line number on the page.

human_corrected.description: True if this word was manually corrected or approved by a human reviewer.

llm_corrected.description: True if this word was corrected by the LLM agent.

llm_approved.description: True if low confidence token was confirmed as accurate by the LLM agent.

original_word.description: Original raw extracted word prior to correction.

suggested_word.description: Word spelling suggested by the LLM agent.

correction_source.description: Origin of correction: e.g. human, gemini-3.7-flash.

correction_reason.description: Rationale or explanation for the correction or approval.

low_confidence_words.description: List of words with confidence scores strictly below the threshold for rapid auditing.

reason.description: Explanation for the lower confidence rating (e.g. ocr_uncertainty, encoding_anomaly, image_noise).

llm_suggestion.description: Suggested spelling produced by the LLM model.

llm_action.description: Recommended action from the LLM model.

llm_reason.description: LLM rationale for the suggested correction or approval.

llm_suggestions.description: Optional list of LLM-generated audit suggestions for low-confidence tokens.
